title: feat(nm2readslx): neighbor-read of M at t+1 on two-axis same-lock x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Neighbor-read of M (some formed 6-NN carries the identical signed M-set) on same-lock x-probes: HOLD at all four, reverse/face HOLD. Also records the R-style contrast (recover the step as -e in M(q+e)) which differs at every probe. Recomputed: on the whole host neighbor-read of M holds at only ~50% of sites, so the 4/4 at the probes is probe selection, not a law.
